quests.instruction: I have a slim body with black spots built for speed. I live sprinting across the open plains. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the cheetah! It has a slim body with black spots built for speed and lives sprinting across the open plains.
quests.funFact: A cheetah is the fastest land animal in the whole world!

quests.instruction: I have thick fur and sharp claws. I live in a den in the forest. I can walk, climb, and swim. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the bear! It has thick fur and sharp claws and lives in a den in the forest.
quests.funFact: Bears have an amazing sense of smell for finding food!

quests.instruction: I have a black and white 'tuxedo' pattern. I live waddling on the icy Antarctic snow. I can waddle on land and swim fast in water. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the penguin! It has a black and white 'tuxedo' pattern and lives waddling on the icy Antarctic snow.
quests.funFact: Penguins huddle together in big groups to stay warm!

quests.instruction: Which animal can glide gracefully through icy water?
quests.question: Glide gracefully through icy water
quests.hint: This animal lives resting on icy Arctic rocks.
quests.explanation: Yes! The seal can glide gracefully through icy water. It has smooth flippers and big round eyes.
quests.funFact: A seal is clumsy on land but wonderfully graceful in water!

quests.instruction: I have black and white spots and a gentle moo. I live in a green farm pasture. I say "Moo"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the cow! It has black and white spots and a gentle moo and lives in a green farm pasture.
quests.funFact: A cow has four stomachs to help it digest grass!

quests.instruction: I have a black coat with a white stripe. I live wandering through the forest at night. I can waddle calmly, but can act fast to stay safe. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the skunk! It has a black coat with a white stripe and lives wandering through the forest at night.
quests.funFact: A skunk uses a strong smell to keep other animals away!

quests.instruction: Which animal is an amphibian?
quests.question: Amphibian
quests.hint: This animal has dry, bumpy skin.
quests.explanation: Yes! The toad is an amphibian. It lives hopping through a damp garden.
quests.funFact: Toads mostly walk or take short hops instead of long jumps!

quests.instruction: Which animal can glide through water and lie very still?
quests.question: Glide through water and lie very still
quests.hint: This animal lives floating quietly in a river.
quests.explanation: Yes! The crocodile can glide through water and lie very still. It has long jaws and rows of sharp teeth.
quests.funFact: A crocodile's strong tail helps it swim quickly through water!

quests.instruction: What do we call a baby fox?
quests.question: Fox
quests.hint: Baby animal names are often short and sweet, just like a bushy tail and pointed ears.
quests.explanation: That's it! A baby fox is called a kit. Grown-up foxes live creeping through the forest at dusk.
quests.funFact: A fox can hear a tiny sound from far away under snow!

quests.instruction: Which animal has round black and white patches?
quests.question: Round black and white patches
quests.hint: This animal usually lives munching bamboo in a misty forest.
quests.explanation: That's right! The panda has round black and white patches. You can find it munching bamboo in a misty forest.
quests.funFact: Panda cubs are tiny and pink when they are born!

quests.instruction: Which animal can strut and puff up big tail feathers?
quests.question: Strut and puff up big tail feathers
quests.hint: This animal lives on a farm.
quests.explanation: Yes! The turkey can strut and puff up big tail feathers. It has a fan of large tail feathers.
quests.funFact: A turkey can spread its tail feathers into a big fan!

quests.instruction: I have a bushy tail and pointed ears. I live creeping through the forest at dusk. I can trot quietly and pounce. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the fox! It has a bushy tail and pointed ears and lives creeping through the forest at dusk.
quests.funFact: Foxes are clever hunters with excellent hearing!

quests.instruction: I have a curly tail and a horse-shaped head. I live drifting near ocean seaweed. I can float upright and drift slowly. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the seahorse! It has a curly tail and a horse-shaped head and lives drifting near ocean seaweed.
quests.funFact: A seahorse curls its tail around seaweed so it doesn't drift away!

quests.instruction: Which animal makes its home in the jungle?
quests.question: In the jungle
quests.hint: Look for the animal with one or two horns and very thick skin.
quests.explanation: Great job! The rhino lives in the jungle. You can spot it by one or two horns and very thick skin.
quests.funFact: A group of rhinos together is called a crash!

quests.instruction: I have a fluffy woolly coat. I live on a green farm. I say "Baa"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the sheep! It has a fluffy woolly coat and lives on a green farm.
quests.funFact: A sheep's woolly coat can be made into warm sweaters!

quests.instruction: I have eight long, wiggly arms. I live hiding among ocean rocks. I can swim and squeeze through tiny gaps. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the octopus! It has eight long, wiggly arms and lives hiding among ocean rocks.
quests.funFact: An octopus can change color to hide from danger!

quests.instruction: What do we call a group of puffins?
quests.question: Puffin
quests.hint: Think about where puffins usually live: nesting on a cold, rocky cliff.
quests.explanation: Yes! A group of puffins is called a colony. They like to stay together nesting on a cold, rocky cliff.
quests.funFact: A puffin's colorful beak fades and turns duller in winter!

quests.instruction: I have a big furry mane around the face. I live prowling the wild savanna grasslands. I say "Roar"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the lion! It has a big furry mane around the face and lives prowling the wild savanna grasslands.
quests.funFact: A lion's roar can be heard from up to 5 miles away!

quests.instruction: I have a hard shell and two strong pincers. I live scuttling along the sandy beach. I can walk sideways. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the crab! It has a hard shell and two strong pincers and lives scuttling along the sandy beach.
quests.funFact: Crabs use their strong pincers to grab food and stay safe!

quests.instruction: I have a black coat with a white stripe. I live wandering through the forest at night. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the skunk! It has a black coat with a white stripe and lives wandering through the forest at night.
quests.funFact: Skunks are awake mostly at night, looking for food!

quests.instruction: I have a bushy tail and pointed ears. I live creeping through the forest at dusk. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the fox! It has a bushy tail and pointed ears and lives creeping through the forest at dusk.
quests.funFact: A fox can hear a tiny sound from far away under snow!

quests.instruction: I have a hard round shell on the back. I live paddling in a calm pond. I can swim and walk slowly. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the turtle! It has a hard round shell on the back and lives paddling in a calm pond.
quests.funFact: A turtle can pull its head and legs inside its shell to stay safe!

quests.instruction: Can you find the animal that lives in the forest?
quests.question: In the forest
quests.hint: Look for the animal with a bushy tail and pointed ears.
quests.explanation: Great job! The fox lives in the forest. You can spot it by a bushy tail and pointed ears.
quests.funFact: A fox uses its bushy tail for balance and to stay warm!

quests.instruction: Can you spot the animal with round fuzzy ears and a big black nose?
quests.question: Round fuzzy ears and a big black nose
quests.hint: This animal usually lives resting in a eucalyptus tree in Australia.
quests.explanation: That's right! The koala has round fuzzy ears and a big black nose. You can find it resting in a eucalyptus tree in Australia.
quests.funFact: A baby koala also rides in its mother's pouch, just like a kangaroo!

quests.instruction: Can you spot the animal with a big, colorful striped beak?
quests.question: A big, colorful striped beak
quests.hint: This animal usually lives nesting on a cold, rocky cliff.
quests.explanation: That's right! The puffin has a big, colorful striped beak. You can find it nesting on a cold, rocky cliff.
quests.funFact: Puffins can carry many small fish in their beak at once!

quests.instruction: Which animal can float, dive, and slide playfully?
quests.question: Float, dive, and slide playfully
quests.hint: This animal lives floating belly-up on a calm river.
quests.explanation: Yes! The otter can float, dive, and slide playfully. It has a sleek body and webbed paws.
quests.funFact: Otters are playful and love to slide down muddy riverbanks!

quests.instruction: I have short horns and a little beard. I live on a rocky farm hillside. I can climb and jump on rocks. What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the goat! It has short horns and a little beard and lives on a rocky farm hillside.
quests.funFact: Goats have rectangle-shaped pupils in their eyes!

quests.instruction: Which animal has a curly, spiral-shaped shell?
quests.question: A curly, spiral-shaped shell
quests.hint: This animal usually lives inching along a garden leaf.
quests.explanation: That's right! The snail has a curly, spiral-shaped shell. You can find it inching along a garden leaf.
quests.funFact: A snail can pull its whole body inside its shell to stay safe!

quests.instruction: One of these animals lives in a garden. Which one?
quests.question: In a garden
quests.hint: Look for the animal with a tiny body and a long thin beak.
quests.explanation: Great job! The hummingbird lives in a garden. You can spot it by a tiny body and a long thin beak.
quests.funFact: A hummingbird can flap its wings over 50 times every second!

quests.instruction: I have a wagging tail and a wet nose. I live in a cozy home as a loyal pet. I say "Woof"! What am I?
quests.question: Solve the riddle!
quests.explanation: Yes, it's the dog! It has a wagging tail and a wet nose and lives in a cozy home as a loyal pet.
quests.funFact: Some clever dogs can learn over 100 words!
